Method of Attack: Abuses NKN public blockchain protocol to carry out flooding attacks and act as a backdoor inside Linux systems
Launches DDoS attacks including HTTP, TCP, UDP, PING, ICMP, and SSL flood attacks
Acts as a remote access trojan (RAT) allowing command execution, data exfiltration, and screenshot capture
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Apache Struts vulnerability CVE-2017-5638
Indicators of Compromise: Use of NKN blockchain protocol for communication
Exploitation of CVE-2017-5638 in financial company attack
